title.en: Does Type 511 mortar spraying need 380 V?

description.en: Yes. Type 511 prints 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤ 6 mm and 30 m / 15 m.
description.zh: 需要。511 印了 380V、7.5 kW、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、粒径 ≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m。

h1.en: Does Type 511 mortar spraying need 380 V?

directAnswer.en: Yes. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Type 511 as a 380 V mortar sprayer: 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 6 mm, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg. If 380 V is absent, the same output window has a diesel page, Type 511 diesel, which is not this machine.
directAnswer.zh: 需要。邢台河北品锦机械把 511 印成 380V 砂浆喷涂机：7.5 kW、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 6 mm、水平 30 m / 垂直 15 m、外形 1700 × 550 × 900 mm、260 kg。如果没有 380V，同一输送量窗口有柴油页，即 511 柴油机，那不是这台机器。

heading.en: ≤ 6 mm and 3 m³/h define the mortar window
heading.zh: ≤ 6 mm 和 3 m³/h 定义砂浆窗口

body.en: Type 311 is finer and smaller: ≤ 2 mm, 2 m³/h, 15 m / 5 m. The German type is 3–5 m³/h, ≤ 5 mm, 8 MPa and 40 m / 20 m. The plunger is 4 m³/h and ≤ 8 mm. Stay on Type 511 when the particle is inside 6 mm, the rate is 3 m³/h and the hose is inside 30 m / 15 m.
body.zh: 311 更细、更小：≤ 2 mm、2 m³/h、15 m / 5 m。德式机是 3–5 m³/h、≤ 5 mm、8 MPa、40 m / 20 m。柱塞机是 4 m³/h、≤ 8 mm。粒径在 6 mm 内、速率是 3 m³/h、软管在 30 m / 15 m 内时，留在 511。

heading.en: It is not a 3 m³/h concrete pump
heading.zh: 它不是 3 m³/h 的混凝土泵

body.en: No trailer pump on this site is listed at 3 m³/h with a 32/38 mm hose. Pipeline pumps print centimetre aggregate and much larger outputs or different distances. Do not ask Type 511 to place structural concrete.
body.zh: 本站没有拖泵被列成 3 m³/h 加 32/38 mm 软管。管道泵印的是厘米骨料，以及大得多的输送量或不同的距离。不要让 511 去浇结构混凝土。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Confirm 380 V for the 7.5 kW motor, or say that supply is missing. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请确认 7.5 kW 电机有 380V，或说明没有这路电源。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: The cell is 3–5 MPa, not 8 MPa. 8 MPa is printed on other sprayers, including the German type.
answer.zh: 这一格是 3–5 MPa，不是 8 MPa。8 MPa 印在其他喷涂机上，包括德式机。

question.en: What if there is no 380 V?

answer.en: Open Type 511 diesel. Do not keep this 7.5 kW page.
answer.zh: 打开 511 柴油机。不要留在这台 7.5 kW 的页面。

answer.en: No. Type 511 electric prints 260 kg. Type 511 diesel prints 360 kg.
answer.zh: 不是。电动 511 印 260 kg。511 柴油机印 360 kg。
